column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God will never put you down! Nor will He belittle you; rather, He builds you up. When God speaks to you, He speaks from the perspective that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and you have accepted it. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and mighty things, which you do not know.” Does that sound like it belittles you or like gloom and doom? There is no darkness and gloom in God, so He cannot say anything to you that is grim or bleak. You have to tune in to the world’s news service to hear gloom and doom.
